name: post.create_draft
description: Makes a post from the composer, under the client's id. The same id again answers with the post it made, also when both arrive at once (the conflict re-reads the committed row); an id another brand holds is refused.
sql:
with b as (select linked from brandbase.brands where id = :brand),
made as (
  insert into brandbase.posts as x (id, brand_id, format, hook, day, time, caption, channels, media, draft)
  select :id, :brand, :format, :hook, :day::date, :time, coalesce(:caption, ''),
    case when :channels::jsonb is null then brandbase.default_channels(:format, b.linked)
    else array(select c from jsonb_array_elements_text(:channels::jsonb) with ordinality t(c, n) group by c order by min(n)) end,
    coalesce(:media::jsonb, '[]'), coalesce(:draft::jsonb, '{}')
  from b
  on conflict (id) do update set id = excluded.id where x.brand_id = excluded.brand_id
  returning x.*
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = m.id), '[]')) as result
from made m
